name: Jeong Dokgo
source:
"With your talent, I believe you can change the world."

Physics teacher and AI scientist.

A teacher who offered another possibility to the protagonist during her wandering days. He now fells a sense of regret watching her change her extracurricular activities. On the other hand, he supports the path she has chosen and never hesitates to offer his advice.
